papers.authors: Allan Kardec de Almeida Junior, Timothée Vaillant, João P. F. Agostinho, Antonio F. B. A. Prado, Leonardo B. T. Santos
papers.evidence: 地月三维转移轨道最优设计与轨迹优化
papers.tldr: 三维地月转移通常比平面转移消耗更多燃料，但受发射场纬度和目标月球轨道倾角影响，实际任务中仍不可或缺。针对其参数维度高、最优解搜索困难的问题，本文提出一种三维转移设计方法：对每次点火施加切向速度约束，并基于函数连接理论（TFC）的过约束技术进行建模。该方法能以数值高效方式搜索最优解，并已用于系统研究最优三维地月转移，也可推广至其他三维机动设计。
papers.abstract_en: Three dimensional Earth-Moon transfers usually consume more fuel than planar ones, but are needed depending on the latitude of the launch site and the desired inclination of the final lunar orbit. A systematic search of the optimal 3D transfers represents a true challenge due the dimension of the parameter set to span. In this paper, we propose a new method to design 3D transfers using a tangential velocity constraint for the burns, modeled using the overdetermined constraints technique based on the Theory of Functional Connections for an optimal search of solutions in a numerically efficient way. The developed method is applied here for a systematic study of optimal 3D Earth-Moon transfers, but could be used to design any type of 3D maneuvers.
